LEVEL REWARDS

Rewards

Win a level for the first time to earn coins for power-ups and themes.

First clear: 15 coins for one star, 20 for two stars, or 25 for three stars. Cleared levels remain unlocked and can be replayed whenever you like; replaying does not farm coins. Daily visits also give 5 coins and one hint token.
